dsh full-text search is opt-in by defaul:
dsh full-text search is opt-in by default: the session-query index has openAt: "never" (disabled), so session.search is unavailable.
To enable: edit ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml, append the following config, then restart the dsh service:
- id: session-query-sqlite
  config:
    path: !!js dshHomePath("session-query.sqlite")
    openAt: first-search
